name: Varaine Pellingare

abilities.name: Slash
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Smite
abilities.description: A heavy melee attack that deals high physical damage and knocks the target down. This attack should be blocked or dodged if possible.

abilities.name: Spinning Cleave
abilities.description: The boss spins around dealing moderate physical damage and knocking players down as indicated by a red circle around himself.

abilities.name: Tidal Slash
abilities.description: The boss smashes the ground causing a wave of water that deals moderate physical damage and knocks players back as indicated by a red cone. This attack has a fast cast time and can be hard to avoid if you are standing too near the boss.

abilities.name: Poisoned Blade
abilities.description: The boss throws a poisoned dagger at a target dealing moderate poison damage over time.

notes: When walking by a nearby guard tower before completing the dungeons, Master Pellingare comments that his son is "a sniveling coward".

summary: Varaine Pellingare is a Breton noble who, along with his sister, is the leader of a potential coup in Wayrest. Their forces have been preparing down in the Wayrest Sewers. Varaine Pellingare is killed in Wayrest Sewers I, and as a result, his mourning father made a deal with Investigator Garron to have him raised from the dead. He returns in the final battle of Wayrest Sewers II, fighting alongside his sister. He will use a variety of melee attacks, while Allene uses ranged attacks.
